card.name: Dosage section headings in labels
card.fires_on: Words inside or ending numbered Dosage and Administration section headings (like 2.1 Overview, Recommended Dosage), right where the heading text turns into the section body.

modes.label: Overview after section number
modes.description: The word Overview right after a section number like 2.1 or 2.3 in the dosage section.
modes.example: 2.3<< Overview>> of TRIUMEQ Dosage Forms TRI

modes.label: End of Dosage heading words
modes.description: The last piece of a heading word such as Dosage or Administration, just before the section text begins.
modes.example: 2.1 Recommended Dos<<age>> The recommended dosage regimen is a single loading

modes.label: Other heading starts
modes.description: Heading words following a heading, such as a drug name or a comma in a heading list.
modes.example: 2.2 Preparation, Administration<<,>> and Image Acquisition Preparation Choose an appropriate D

card.plain: It fires on the headings of the Dosage and Administration section of a drug label, at the point where the heading ends.
